about: Origin marks of this unit's data. sourced: taken from the credited source, only its format or coordinates converted; derived: made from sourced data by a fixed rule; adapted: source content changed by judgement; made: no source content; unknown: not recorded. A figure field resolves as figures[id][field], then default[field], then unknown; a field a figure does not have is not listed. names and readings mark each name and kana reading of the unit's names.json (and culture_name its culture.json); none of the built-in files has a figure name or a reading. "*" is the file's own default name.
